scientific_integrity: Exact proof uses trapezoid and slice polynomial moments; 96 independent rational tetrahedral integrations corroborate identities but do not prove the universal theorem.
scientific_limitations: Canonical standard-coordinate mixed covariance, homothetic trapezoidal frusta only, not arbitrary prismatoids or affine-invariant isotropy; historical priority may be affected by unindexed equivalent moment formulas.
title: A sharp covariance-sign transition in trapezoidal rational-linear-precision prismatoids
